This role focuses on developing and supporting advanced power infrastructure solutions for hyperscale and colocation (COLO) data center customers across the United States.

title: Sr Director/VP of Supply Chain & Manufacturing
description:
**About Flux Power**

Flux Power Holdings (NASDAQ: FLUX) designs and assembles lithium\-ion battery packs for the industrial and material handling market — forklifts, AGVs, and commercial fleet equipment across North America. With 30,000\+ packs deployed, the company achieved profitability in late 2025 and is investing in the leadership team that will take it through its next phase of growth.

As an assembler and integrator, Flux Power’s ability to manage and develop its supplier and manufacturing base is one of its most important competitive advantages. This role sits at the center of that work.

**The Opportunity**

This is a newly created senior leadership role reporting directly to the CEO. The Sr. Director / VP of Supply Chain \& Manufacturing Operations will own the company’s end\-to\-end supply chain strategy, vendor relationships, procurement, and manufacturing assembly operations. It is a high\-visibility position with direct influence over gross margin, customer delivery performance, and the company’s long\-term sourcing strategy.

This is an opportunity to build and shape a function — establishing the processes, supplier partnerships, and team development that will support the company for years to come. The right leader will thrive in a fast\-moving environment, bring structure where it is needed, and lead with confidence and clarity.

* **Supply chain strategy:** Define and own the company’s approach to sourcing, vendor development, and supplier relationships — including establishing a dual\-sourcing strategy to create leverage and reduce risk.
* **Vendor negotiation and management:** Build strong, trusted relationships with contract manufacturers and key suppliers. Visit facilities, understand production processes and cost structures, and negotiate with confidence at the table.

description:

title: Chemical Engineer Co-Op
description:
Overview:

Storion is an innovative stored energy components and solutions provider focusing on LDES (Long Duration Energy Storage) flow batteries. Storion Energy converts Western\-friendly sources of mined and recycled vanadium oxides into the high\-quality electrolyte, which is the heart of a vanadium redox flow battery (VRFB). With infinite electrolyte recyclability, Storion is making earth\-to\-energy a reality.  

  

Storion's new production facility and operations lab are located north of Atlanta in Alpharetta, GA. This is a paid Co\-Op position with the expectation that students will rotate semesters between work and school. We are looking for Chemical Engineering students for a Co\-Op beginning in the summer of 2027\.
Responsibilities:
Responsibilities and assignments may include:* Working on product development
* Hands\-on testing in the R\&D Lab
* Data processing and analysis
* Chemical Process design, control, and operation development
* Kinetics determination and modeling
* Unit operation design/equipment specification
* Process documentation
* Material compatibility testing
* Many more exciting and challenging experiences


Past Co\-Ops gained knowledge in experimental design (DOE), R\&D processes, and professional development.
Qualifications:
We are looking for students:* Working towards a BS in Chemical Engineering
* With a GPA of 3\.0 or greater
* You must have housing and transportation
* The position requires working on\-site daily


Our environment is casual but professional, and our Co\-Ops are exposed to senior\-level leaders. If this sounds good to you, then it’s your time to shine! We don’t want our Co\-Ops to sit on the sidelines – we want you to challenge us and provide creative ways to approach projects.

title: AI Storage Infrastructure Engineer - remote in the US
description:
**Company Description** **About Mirantis**


Mirantis is the Kubernetes\-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data\-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production\-ready developer platforms across any environment—on\-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI\-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy\-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock\-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

 **Job Description** **Overview**


The role is to deploy, integrate, and operate high\-performance storage for GPU\-accelerated compute and AI platforms. You will own the storage layer where Kubernetes meets bare metal — standing up NFS\-based high\-performance storage, wiring it into clusters via CSI, and tuning it to keep data flowing to GPU workloads at scale. Work spans hybrid, edge, and air\-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack.

**About the Role**


We are looking for a senior systems engineer who treats storage as infrastructure to be automated, observed, and tuned — not hand\-managed. The right candidate is fluent in Kubernetes storage, deeply versed in Linux storage and networking fundamentals down to the kernel and NFS\-client layer, and knows how to make high\-performance NAS actually perform under demanding workloads. You should reach for infrastructure\-as\-code and GitOps by default, be self\-directed in diagnosing performance and reliability issues end to end, set operational standards for others to follow, and communicate clearly across teams.
